_about: A model of a bundle's databricks.yml as JSON. variables holds custom variables (default, description); a target's variables override them for that target. ${var.name} reads a variable. A target's mode is development or production; one target may be default. run_as names user_name or service_principal_name. git.branch is the branch a production deploy must come from.

needs.dev: Each engineer deploys to the dev workspace by default, with no -t, and dev schedules stay paused. Tables go to the dev catalog.
needs.test: CI deploys to the test workspace. Tables go to the test catalog.
needs.prod: Deployed only from the main branch, running as the service principal kf-deployer, in the prod workspace. Tables go to the prod catalog.

catalog.description: The catalog the job writes to
